title: pvMergeBlocks
body:
## pvMergeBlocks

Full native Merge Blocks: appends the leaf datasets of a composite input into one dataset. OutputDataSetType decides the result: Unstructured Grid (ParaView default) merges blocks of any type, Polygonal Mesh merges only polydata blocks and leaves others out. MergePartitionsOnly keeps the block hierarchy and merges only the partitions within each block. Use merge for the common case (merge everything with point merging); use this when you need polydata output, a merge tolerance or partition-only merging.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- With Polygonal Mesh output, volume meshes and image blocks are silently omitted; extract their surfaces first if they must be included.
- Tolerance is a fraction of the bounding-box diagonal unless ToleranceIsAbsolute is true.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `MergeBlocks`. Identity: `filters/MergeBlocks`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: Set the input composite dataset. Accepted data: data-object trees (multiblock or partitioned) (vtkDataObjectTree). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataObjectTree"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `MergePartitionsOnly` | When set, only paritions and pieces will be merged into a dataset each, instead of merging everything into a single dataset. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `MergePoints` | Merge points within a distance specified by the **Tolerance** property. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `OutputDataSetType` | Determines the output type produced by this filter. Only blocks compatible with the output type will be merged in the output. For example, if the output type is "Polygonal Mesh", then blocks of type "Image Data", "Structured Grid", etc. will not be merged. If the output type is "UnstructuredGrid", then blocks of any type will be merged in the output. Defaults to "Unstructured Grid". | `{"type":"enum","values":["Polygonal Mesh","Unstructured Grid"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Polygonal Mesh"` |
| `Tolerance` | Set the tolerance for merging points if **Merge Points** is enabled. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `ToleranceIsAbsolute` | This property determines whether to treat the **Tolerance** property as absolute (points closer than Tolerance are merged) or relative (points closer than a fraction of the input data's bounding box diagonal length) when performing point merging. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvMergeBlocks",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
